record_reconciliation.open_problem: D's two numbers are self-consistent with each other (16+31 = 47 wins, 5+11 = 16 losses), so the official line reads as entering + tonight = season. What has no backing is the tonight figure itself: 31-11 is 42 plays, and no artifact in this repo contains 42 plays for this game. The repo-tracked card is 21 plays (14-6 as rows, 15-7 as legs); the vault package auto-grade is 61 settled rows (39-22). Neither is 31-11, and neither arithmetic bridge produces 31-11: 16+14 = 30 wins / 5+6 = 11 losses, and 16+15 = 31 wins / 5+7 = 12 losses. So the official tonight number is owner-stated with no in-repo reconciliation, and the 19-to-40 plays that would have to make up the difference are unnamed anywhere. UNRESOLVED — owner decision required; nothing here substitutes a number.
